questions.question_english:
What is the minimum age requirement, as prescribed by the Constitution, to become a
member of a Panchayat?

questions.explanation: According to the Constitution of India, the minimum age to become a member of a Panchayat is 21 years. This is specified in Article 243 of the Constitution, which outlines the framework for the Panchayati Raj system. The other options (18, 28, and 36 years) do not align with the constitutional requirement for Panchayat membership.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is a vector borne disease?

questions.explanation: Malaria is a vector-borne disease caused by parasites transmitted through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes. The other options listed (Diabetes, Breast Cancer, and Covid-19) are not vector-borne diseases; they are either metabolic or viral diseases that do not require a vector for transmission.

questions.question_english:
With reference to the constitutional provisions regarding Rajya Sabha, which of the
following statements is correct?

options_english: The Attorney General of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabh
The Prime Minister of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabh
The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabh
The President of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabh
options_hindi: भारत के अटॉर्नी जनरल राज्य सभा के पदेन अध्यक्ष हैं
भारत के प्रधानमंत्री राज्य सभा के पदेन अध्यक्ष हैं
भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति राज्य सभा के पदेन अध्यक्ष हैं
भारत के राष्ट्रपति राज्य सभा के पदेन अध्यक्ष हैं
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option C: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio chairman of the Rajya Sabha. The other options are incorrect because the Attorney General, Prime Minister, and President do not hold the position of chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question_english:
